summary: Glimpse Group filed an 8-K disclosing a registered direct offering: 622,306 common shares plus warrants for ~4.19M shares, plus pre-funded warrants for ~2.73M shares. Combined price is $0.55 per share/common warrant unit ($0.549 for pre-funded unit). Net proceeds ~$1.79M; no placement agent used. The offering is an equity capital raise, not a return of capital, but is classified as Capital Returns (issuer capital markets activity). Close expected May 18, 2026. Watch investor warrant exercise and dilution overhang.
